name: IP Fabric
description: Discovers a network read-only over SSH and APIs and builds a mathematically accurate digital twin of its actual, current state. The agent-facing piece is an Enterprise MCP Server that lets tools like Claude or Copilot query that twin directly (end-to-end path lookups, shadow firewall rules, missing segmentation) instead of guessing from general networking knowledge.
